claim: For the Neumann–Kirchhoff path and three-arm star with the same edge lengths (ε,a,b), with a,b positive and unequal, the short-edge moment response A₁₁=ε∂ε E₁ in the normalized first positive mode is asymptotic to −ε/[3(a+b)] on the path and −ε cos²(πa/(a+b))/[3(a+b)] on the star. Their ratio also describes the quadratic coefficients of the explicit length-cycle functional defined in arXiv:2210.14652v1, not the Berry phase of the 2024 article.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity: First positive simple eigenbranch only, with fixed unequal a,b and ε tending to zero. The functional comparison uses an amplitude expansion at fixed ε. It is not an expansion of the published adiabatic Berry phase.
title: A short-edge spectral response distinguishes endpoint and hub attachment
